testsuite.name: com.example.smartshuffle.domain.RankingEngineTest

testcase.name: song ranked at t=0 returns effective rank 0 at t = 3 days
song ranked at t=0 returns full rankValue when queried at t=0
song ranked at t=0 returns effective rank 0 when well past decay period
selectNextShuffleSong returns null when no valid candidates
weighted selection favors rank-0 song over high-rank songs
weighted selection picks every song at least occasionally with equal ranks
song with no SongRank entry returns effective rank 0
SHUFFLE increment is exactly double MANUAL increment
song ranked at t=0 returns half rankValue at t = 1_5 days
large rank disparity still allows occasional selection of high-rank songs
automated reproduction test - fill buffer 50 times and check for duplicates
selectNextShuffleSong returns null when library is empty
re-play before full decay stacks correctly on decaying value
